test_title: PYST 64: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The long-standing __feud __between the two villages was settled due to the intervention of the two chiefs.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Harmony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"feud"** means a prolonged and bitter quarrel or dispute. (झगड़ा, विवाद)

 
 
• **Example: **The feud between the two families lasted for generations.
 
 
 
• **"Harmony"** refers to a state of being in agreement or concord, free from disputes and conflicts. (सद्भाव)
 
 
• **Example: **The two communities lived in harmony after the peace agreement was signed.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'feud'** is **'harmony'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Harmony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Humility** (विनम्रता): A modest or low view of one's own importance.

 
 
• **Example:** Her humility made her very approachable despite her achievements.
 
 
 
• **Humble** (विनम्र): Having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's importance.
 
 
• **Example: **He remained humble even after winning the prestigious award.
 
 
 
• **Honesty** (ईमानदारी): The quality of being truthful and sincere.
 
 
• **Example:** His honesty is one of the reasons why people trust him so much.
